free_tier.stated: Chinese GPU cloud and hosted notebook with published per-hour rates: RTX 4090 quoted at CNY 1.87 per hour on 16 AMD EPYC 9354 cores, 60 GB RAM and 750 GB of free disk; RTX 3090 quoted at CNY 1.62 per hour on 6 Xeon Gold 6142 cores, 60 GB RAM and 450 GB disk; PRO 6000 at CNY 6.19 per hour. At USD 1 = CNY 6.6743 that is USD 0.280, USD 0.243 and USD 0.927 per GPU-hour. PyTorch and TensorFlow images are preinstalled and billing is on demand or by monthly subscription.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: The 750 GB of free instance disk alongside a 4090 is larger than any Western broker's included disk at this rate, which matters for a dataset-heavy fine-tune.

limits.value: The account is a Chinese mobile number plus an SMS code and the site publishes no alternate registration route, so the same identity wall as AutoDL applies.
